verses.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.sm: Nepukanesa le tupu, o lau upu lenei i nuu uma, ma atunuu, ma gagana eseese o e nonofo i le lalolagi uma, ia tupu tele so outou manuia.

verses.en: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.
verses.sm: Sa aʻu manatu e tatau ona aʻu faailoa atu faailoga ma vavega na faia ia te au e le Atua silisili ese.

verses.en: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.sm: O ona faailoga ua matua tetele, o ona vavega ua mamana lava ia; o lona malo o le malo e faavavau lea, o lana pule e au tupulaga lea.

verses.en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:
verses.sm: O aʻu o Nepukanesa sa aʻu filemu i loʻu fale, sa aʻu manuia foi i loʻu maota.

verses.en: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.sm: Na fai laʻu miti na ou fefe ai, o oʻu manatunatu foi i loʻu moega atoa ma mea na ou vaaia sa Ou atuatuvale ai.

verses.en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.sm: Ona aʻu pule lea ia aumaia i oʻu luma le au popoto uma o i Papelonia, ina ia latou faailoa mai ia te au le uiga o le miti.

verses.en: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o taulaitu, ma vaafaatau, ma le au Kaletaia, atoa ma e o popoto i fetu, ona aʻu ta‘uina atu lea o le miti ia te i latou, a ua latou le faailoa mai ia te au lona uiga.

verses.en: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane, ua sau i oʻu luma Tanielu, o lona igoa o Peletisara, ua i ai le igoa o loʻu atua, o loo i ai foi le agaga o atua paia, ona aʻu taʻuina atu lea ia te ia laʻu miti, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.sm: Peletisara e, o łe matai o taulaitu, aua ua ou iloa o loo ia te oe le agaga O atua paia, e leai se mea lilo e faigata ia te oe; ia e taʻu mai ia te au o faaaliga na ou vaaia i laʻu miti, atoa ma lona uiga.

verses.en: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.
verses.sm: O faaaliga ia na aʻu iloa i loʻu moega; faauta, na aʻu iloa le laau i totonu o le lalolagi, ua tele lava lona maualuga.

verses.en: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
verses.sm: Ua tupu tele le laau, ma na malosi, o lona maualuga foi ua oo i le lagi, ua iloa mai o ia i le tuluiga o le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
verses.sm: Ua matagofie ona lau, ma lona fua ua tele, ua i ai foi mea e “ai ma mea uma, ua faapaoloina i ona lalo ifo o manu o le vao; o ona la ua toaga i ai manu felelei, ua aai ai lava o mea ola uma.

verses.en: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
verses.sm: Na ou vaaia i faaaliga i loʻu moega, faauta, O le leoleo, o le ua paia, ua alu ifo ia mai le lagi.

verses.en: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
verses.sm: Ua alaga tele o ia, ua faapea atu, Ina tuu ia i lalo le laau, ma vavae ese ona la; ina lulu ese ia ona lau, ma faataapeape ona fua; ina ia sosola manu ai ona lalo ifo, ma manu felelei ai ona la.

verses.en: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:
verses.sm: A o le tagutugutu o lona pogai, tuu ai pea ia i le eleele, ia mau ai i le fusi uamea ma le “apa memea 11e mutia O le vao; ia faasusuina i le sau mai le lagi, ia fai foi lona tofi faatasi ma manu i le mutia o le laueleele;

verses.en: Let his heart be changed from man's, and let a beast's heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.
verses.sm: ia liua lona loto tagata, ma ia tuuina atu ia te ia le loto o le manu, seia mavae atu ona tausaga e fitu.

verses.en: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.
verses.sm: O le pule a le au leoleo lenei mea, o le upu a le au paia ua ala ai lenei mea, ina ia iloa e tagata ola ua pule le Silisili ese i le malo o tagata, ua tuuina atu ai i le ua ia finagalo i ai, e tofia fol e ia e pwe i ai tagata ua aupito faatauvaa.

verses.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou art able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee.
verses.sm: O le miti lava lena na Ou vaaia, o aʻu o Nepukanesa le tupu; o oe foi Peletisara e, ina E taʻu mai ia lona uiga, aua e le mafaia e le au popoto uma i lo‘u malo ona faailoa mai ia te au le uiga; a e mafai ia te oe; aua o loo ia te Oe le agaga o atua paia.

verses.en: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.
verses.sm: Ona fememeai ai lea o Tanielu, ua igoa ia Peletisara, pe atoa le itu la e tasi, ua atuatuvale foi i lona manatunatu. Ona fai atu lea o le tupu, ua faapea atu, Peletisara e, aua e te atuatuvale i le miti po o lona uiga. Ua talr mai Peletisara, ua faapea mai, oku alii e, ia i aii e o ita atu ia te oe le faalepo; ia i ai i e o fai oe mo latou fili lona uiga.

verses.en: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
verses.sm: O le laau na e silafia, sa tupu tele ma le malosi, o lona maualuga ua oo i le lagi, ua iloa mai i le lalolagi uma;

verses.en: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:
verses.sm: O ona lau ua matagofie, ma ona fua ua tele, ua i ai foi mea e ‘ai mà mea uma; ua nonofo i ona lalo ifo manu o le vao, ua toaga foi i ona la o manu felelei,

verses.en: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.sm: le tupu e, o oe lava lea; ua tupu tele ma ua malosi, aua o lou mamalu ua tele, ua oo i le lagi, o lau pule foi ua oo i le tuluiga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;
verses.sm: Na silafia e le tupu, o le leoleo, o le ua paia, ua alu ifo ia mai le lagi, ua faapea atu, Ina tuu ia i lalo le laau, ma faataumaoi i ai, a o le tagutugutu o lona pogai, tuu ai pea ia i le eleele, ia mau ai i le fusi uamea ma le “apa memea i le mutia o le vao; ia faasusuina ai foi i le sau mai le lagi, ia fai foi lona tofi faatasi ma manu o le vao, seia mavae atu ona tausaga e fitu.

verses.en: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:
verses.sm: Le tupu e, o lona uiga lenei, o le pule lava lenei a le Silisili ese ua oo atu i loʻu alii le tupu;

verses.en: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
verses.sm: e tulia oe ia te“a ma tagata, a e mau oe faatasi ma manu o le vao; e te taumafa i le mutia e pei o povi, e susu oe i le sau mai le lagi, e mavae atu ai ou tausaga e fitu, seia e silafia ua pule le Silisili ese i le malo o tagata, na te tuuina atu ai foi i le ua ia finagalo i ai.

verses.en: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
verses.sm: Na fetalaia mai foi e tuu ai pea le tagutugutu o lona pogai; e tumau pea lau nofoaiga, e fai mo oe pe a E silafia ua pule Le o i le lagi.

verses.en: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
verses.sm: O lenei, le tupu e, ia malie laʻu upu ia te oe, ia e lafoai au agasala, a E fai le amiotonu, ia e lafoai au amio faapiopio, a e alofa i e matitiva, pè mafai ona faalevaleva ane ai lou filemu.

verses.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.sm: Na co ia mea uma ia Nepukanesa le tupu.

verses.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
verses.sm: Ua mavae masina e sefulu ma le lua ona fealuai ai lea o ia i luga o le maota o le malo i Papelonia.

verses.en: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
verses.sm: Ua fai ane le tupu, ua faapea ane, E le o Papelonia tele ea lenei, na aʻu faia i loʻu malosi tele lava, e fai ma fale o le malo, ia viia ai foi loʻu mamalu?

verses.en: While the word was in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.
verses.sm: A o tautala mai le tupu, ua tulei ifo le siufofoga mai le lagi, ua faapea mai, Nepukanesa e, le tupu, o le fai atu nei ia te oe, ua te“a ma oe le malo.

verses.en: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
verses.sm: E tulia oe ia tea ma tagata, e te mau faatasi ma manu o le vao, e te “ai i le mutia e pei o povi, e mavae atu ai ou tausaga e fitu, seia e iloa ua pule le Silisili ese i le malo o tagata, na te tuuina atu i ai foi i le ua ia finagalo i ai.

verses.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
verses.sm: O lea lava itu aso na taunuu ai le upu ia Nepukanesa; ona tulia lea o ia mai tagata, ua “ai foi o ia i mutia pei , povi, ua susu lona tino i le sau mai le lagi, ua oo ina tutupu o lona lauulu ua pei o fulufulu o aeto, ma ona matiuu ua pei o atigivae o manu felelei.

verses.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:
verses.sm: Ua uma ia aso, ona ou faasaga ae ai lea oʻu mata i le lagi, o aʻu o Nepukanesa, ona afu toe atamai ai lea; ona ou faafetai ai lea i le Silisili ese, ua ou faaneenee atu foi ma vivii atu ia te ia o le soifua e faavavau, o lana pule o le pule e faavavau lea, o lona malo foi e au tupulaga lava lea.

verses.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.sm: O i latou uma o e nonofo i le lalolagi, ua peiseai ua leai i latou; ua ia faia foi e tusa ma lona finagalo i ‘au o le lagi, atoa ma e o nonofo i le lalolagi; e leai se tasi na te taofia lona aao, pe fai atu ia te ia, O le a ea le mea e te fai na?

verses.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
verses.sm: O ona po lava ia ua ou toe atamai ai; ua toe foi mai ia te au loʻu mamalu ma loʻu matagofie, ina ia mamalu ai loʻu malo; o oʻu tulafale foi ma alii sa ia te au, ua latou saili ia te au, ua faatumauina foi aʻu i loʻu malo, ma ua faaopoopoina mai ia te au le mamalu e tele.

verses.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.
verses.sm: O lenei, o aʻu o Nepukanesa ou te faamanu atu, ma vivii atu, ma faaneenee atu i le Tupu o le lagi, e faamaoni ana galuega uma, ma ona ala ua tonu; na te mafaia foi ona faamaulaloina e o savavali ma le faamaualuga.
